original_title: Alix Wilton Regan on Becoming Lara Croft in Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis | IGN Live 2026
summary_en: The iconic Lara Croft is getting a fresh start in Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, and actress Alix Wilton Regan is ready to embody the legendary adventurer. Regan shared insights into her portrayal of both a younger and older Lara across upcoming titles.
ai_analysis: With a remake of the original, a new actor stepping into Lara's iconic boots, and a dual-age portrayal, Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis aims to honor the franchise's legacy while pushing its narrative forward for a modern audience.

en.title: Alix Wilton Regan Steps Into Lara Croft's Boots for Tomb Raider Remake
en.summary: The iconic Lara Croft is getting a fresh start in Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, and actress Alix Wilton Regan is ready to embody the legendary adventurer. Regan shared insights into her portrayal of both a younger and older Lara across upcoming titles.
en.body:
The enduring legacy of **Lara Croft** is set to be re-explored with the upcoming remake, **Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis**, scheduled for release in 2027. Taking on the monumental task of voicing and performing motion capture for the beloved archaeologist is **Alix Wilton Regan**, known for her work on titles like **Assassin's Creed Origins** and **Dota: Dragon's Blood**. Regan expressed her excitement and deep admiration for the character, calling it an "amazing" experience to step into the shoes of such a "global icon."

During a panel at IGN Live 2026, Regan delved into the nuances of her performance, particularly highlighting the challenge and excitement of portraying Lara at different stages of her life. She is not only lending her voice to the younger Lara in **Legacy of Atlantis** but will also embody an older version in the upcoming **Tomb Raider: Catalyst**. "You break them down as much as possible," Regan explained regarding her approach to differentiating the characters. "You ask your collaborators to help you keep track of it because it is tricky. We’re trying to do something different with the voice in each game."

## Honoring the Past, Defining the Future

**Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis** promises to be a faithful yet reimagined take on the 1996 original that defined a genre. Regan revealed that the development team has carefully incorporated some of the most memorable lines from the first game, infusing them with a modern sensibility. "Just getting to play those lines with kind of that 90s sass being brought up to 2026," she shared, emphasizing the blend of nostalgia and contemporary flair. The actress also teased a "brilliant cast attached" for the project, although details remain under wraps, adding another layer of anticipation for fans eager to see who else will join this ambitious revival.

## The Croft Legacy Continues

For long-time fans, the return to Lara's origins is a cause for celebration, and the choice of **Alix Wilton Regan** has been met with keen interest. Her commitment to differentiating the character across various ages suggests a thoughtful approach that respects the character's evolution while forging a new path. The remake's announcement at The Game Awards 2025, followed by this deeper dive at IGN Live, signals a significant investment in the **Tomb Raider** franchise, aiming to capture both the nostalgia of its roots and the excitement of a new generation of players.

## What's Next

With **Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis** slated for a 2027 release, fans can expect further details and potentially gameplay reveals in the coming months. The dual portrayal of Lara by **Alix Wilton Regan** across **Legacy of Atlantis** and **Catalyst** promises a comprehensive exploration of the character's journey.

tr.title: Alix Wilton Regan, Tomb Raider: Atlantis'in Yeniden Yaratıcısı
tr.summary: Alix Wilton Regan, Lara Croft'un yeniden yükselişini Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis ile yaşayacak. Oyuncu, genç ve yaşlı Lara'yı canlandıran farklı rolleri paylaştı.
tr.body:
Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, 2027'de çıkacak olan bu yeniden yapımı, Lara Croft'un efsanevi macerasını yeniden keşfetmek için hazırlanıyor. Belirtilen görevi, bu sevimli arkeoloğu seslendirmek ve hareket yakalama için performans sergilemek, Assassin's Creed Origins ve Dota: Dragon's Blood gibi projelerde tanınan Alix Wilton Regan'a verildi. Regan, karaktere olan hayranlığını ve bu "dünya ikonuna" adım atmanın "hayal kırıklığı" olmadığını dile getirdi.

Regan, IGN Live 2026 panelinde performansını anlatırken, özellikle genç ve yaşlı Lara'yı canlandırmayı başarmakla ilgili zorlukları ve heyecanını paylaştı. Regan, Legacy of Atlantis'te genç Lara'yı seslendirecekken, Catalyst'te ise yaşlı Lara'yı canlandıracak. Oyuncu, farklı rolleri ayırt etmek için ne yaptıklarını açıkladı: "Onları mümkün olduğunca parçalayın", "kolaboratörlerinizi size yardımcı olmalarını isteyin, çünkü bu zor." Regan, seslerin farklılaşmasını sağlamak için çalıştıklarını ve bu farklılaşma için ekibinin desteklerini aldıklarını belirtti.

## Efsanevi Macera Yeniden Canlandırılıyor

Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, 1996 orijinalini yeniden canlandırarak, 90'ların sınırlarını yenileyen bir macera olarak tanımlanıyor. Regan, oyunun geliştiricilerinin, orijinali yeniden canlandırmak için bazı hatırlanabilir satırları kullandıklarını ve bunları modern bir sensibiliteye kavuşturduklarını paylaştı. Oyuncu, oyunun geliştiricilerinin, 90'ların sınırlarını yenileyen bir macera olarak tanımlanacaklarını ve bu sınırları yenileyen bir yapıya kavuşturduklarını belirtti.

## Efsanevi Macera Devam Ediyor

Eski fans, Lara Croft'un yeniden yükselişine olan sevinçleri, oyuncunun seçimine olan ilgisini artırdı. Regan'ın, farklı rolleri canlandırmak için gösterdiği çaba, karakterin evrimini saygı duyururken, yeni bir yol açıyor. Oyunun geliştiricilerinin, 2025'te The Game Awards'ta duyurulmasından bu yana, IGN Live 2026 panelinde daha derin bir bakış açısı sunmaları, Tomb Raider serisinin, kökenlerini saygı duyururken, yeni bir neslin heyecanını yakalamak için büyük bir yatırım olduğunu gösteriyor.

## Gelecek

Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, 2027'de çıkacak. Oyuncuların, gelecekte daha fazla ayrıntı ve potansiyel olarak oyun oynamanın nasıl yapılacağına dair bilgiler alabilecekleri bekleniyor. Regan'ın, Legacy of Atlantis ve Catalyst'te Lara'yı canlandırmak için gösterdiği çaba, karakterin macerasını kapsamlı bir şekilde keşfetmeyi vaat ediyor.

es.title: Alix Wilton Regan Pone los Zapatos de Lara Croft para el Remake de Tomb Raider
es.summary: La icónica Lara Croft está por recibir un nuevo comienzo en Tomb Raider: Legado de Atlántida, y la actriz Alix Wilton Regan está lista para encarnar a la aventurera legendaria. Regan compartió sus reflexiones sobre su interpretación de Lara en diferentes etapas de su vida en futuros títulos.
es.body:
La legendaria aventura de **Lara Croft** está por ser reexplorada con el próximo remake, **Tomb Raider: Legado de Atlántida**, programado para su lanzamiento en 2027. Tomando el desafío monumental de voz y captura de movimiento para la arqueóloga querida es **Alix Wilton Regan**, conocida por su trabajo en títulos como **Assassin's Creed Origins** y **Dota: Sangre de Dragón**. Regan expresó su emoción y profundo respeto por el personaje, llamándolo una "experiencia increíble" para ponerse los zapatos de una "icono global".

Durante un panel en IGN Live 2026, Regan se adentró en las sutilezas de su actuación, destacando especialmente el desafío y la emoción de representar a Lara en diferentes etapas de su vida. No solo prestará su voz a la joven Lara en **Legado de Atlántida**, sino que también encarnará una versión más madura en el próximo **Tomb Raider: Catalyst**. "Te desglosan lo más posible", explicó Regan acerca de su enfoque para diferenciar a los personajes. "Pides a tus colaboradores que te ayuden a mantener el ritmo porque es complicado. Estamos tratando de hacer algo diferente con la voz en cada juego".

## Honrando el Pasado, Definiendo el Futuro

**Tomb Raider: Legado de Atlántida** promete ser una toma fiel y reimaginada del original de 1996 que definió un género. Regan reveló que el equipo de desarrollo ha incorporado cuidadosamente algunas de las líneas más memorables del primer juego, infundiéndolas con una sensibilidad moderna. "Justo para jugar esas líneas con un poco de esa sorna de los 90 siendo llevada a 2026", compartió, enfatizando la mezcla de nostalgia y estilo contemporáneo. La actriz también filtró una "cast brillante unido" para el proyecto, aunque los detalles permanecen bajo siete llaves, agregando otra capa de anticipación para los fanáticos ansiosos por ver quién más se une a esta renovación ambiciosa.

## La Legado de Croft Continúa

Para los fanáticos de larga data, el regreso a los orígenes de Lara es una causa de celebración, y la elección de **Alix Wilton Regan** ha sido recibida con interés. Su compromiso para diferenciar al personaje en diferentes edades sugiere un enfoque reflexivo que respete la evolución del personaje mientras forja un nuevo camino. El anuncio del remake en The Game Awards 2025, seguido de esta profundización en IGN Live, indica una inversión significativa en la franquicia **Tomb Raider**, con el objetivo de capturar tanto la nostalgia de sus raíces como la emoción de una nueva generación de jugadores.

## Próximos Pasos

Con **Tomb Raider: Legado de Atlántida** programado para su lanzamiento en 2027, los fanáticos pueden esperar detalles adicionales y posibles revelaciones de juego en los próximos meses. La doble interpretación de Lara por **Alix Wilton Regan** en **Legado de Atlántida** y **Catalyst** promete una exploración exhaustiva del viaje del personaje.

content_raw: Lara Croft is going back to the beginning in the upcoming Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis , a new remake of the original Tomb Raider game from 1996. Taking on the beloved role of Lara Croft for this incarnation is Alix Wilton Regan (Assassin's Creed Origins, Dota: Dragon's Blood), who spoke about the game and her famous character at IGN Live today. During the panel, IGN debuted a snippet of the new "Meet Lara Croft" featurette in which Regan and the game's creators speak about the long legacy of the character and bringing to life her latest incarnation, and which you can watch the full video of above. So what's it like stepping into the shoes (or boots) of a character as well known as Lara Croft? Said Regan, "It’s amazing. Lara is a British cultural icon, she’s a global icon. She is loved and I love her as much as everyone else, so I’m ecstatic." She described Lara as "so completely confident in herself, in her abilities, her brain, her body, her being." Regan doesn't just have Legacy of Atlantis on the way, she's also playing Lara in the upcoming Tomb Raider: Catalyst, where she will embody an older Lara, on the heels of playing the younger version in Legacy of Atlantis. Regarding her approach to keeping the different ages distinct, Regan explained, "You break them down as much as possible. You ask your collaborators to help you keep track of it that because it is tricky. We’re trying to do something different with the voice in each game." Regan revealed that for Legacy of Atlantis, "We’ve lifted some of the most iconic lines from the first Tomb Raider," saying she loved "Just getting to play those lines with kind of that 90s sass being brought up to 2026." She also teased "A brilliant cast attached that I’m really sorry I can’t disclose yet!" Regan admitted the mocap work she'd done for Tomb Raider could be physically taxing, noting "We’ve done huge three week shoots at a time" and laughing "You get a bit hot and sweaty and extremely intimate with your costars doing ten hours in a mocap suit." Regan said for extra inspiration to keep going during those long days, "I spend a lot of time looking at Lara's little avatar on screen... She is so smoking hot! I think we can all agree on that." Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis will be released February 12, 2027 on Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, PC, and Xbox Series X/S. Be sure to keep up with everything going on at IGN Live 2026 . You can check the full schedule to see what else is coming up across games, movies, TV, streaming, and more.
